query:
SELECT d.id
            FROM deliveries d
            LEFT JOIN couriers c ON d.courier_id = c.id
            WHERE
                (
                    d.creator_id = $1
                    OR d.recipient_user_id = $1
                    OR c.user_id = $1
                )
                AND d.status <> 'completed'::delivery_status
            ORDER BY d.requested_at DESC
            LIMIT $2
